A '''witch''' in [[Matcha Flavoured]] is a reliable source of {{ItemLink|Estus Ash}}, dropping 4–8 when killed by a player. Like other non-undead mobs, witches can't spawn under the open sky in the Overworld.

== Spawning ==
Witches use the vanilla spawn lists, except that the pale garden spawns no monsters. A witch that appears in the Overworld where it can see the sky is removed at once, and after the [[Ender Dragon]] is killed it is also removed at Y=63 or above.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/spawn_mechanic/check_mob_spawn.mcfunction}}</ref> See [[Spawning]].

== Drops ==
{{Data/Loot/minecraft/entities/witch}}
All drops require a player kill.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/witch.json}}</ref> Compared to vanilla:
* the 1–3 random drops are red mushrooms, brown mushrooms (twice as likely), spider eyes or glass bottles, 0–2 each; sugar, sticks, gunpowder and glowstone dust are removed;
* the guaranteed 4–8 redstone is replaced by 4–8 {{ItemLink|Estus Ash}}.
